onboarding.welcome.setup.title: Welcome to Homie
onboarding.welcome.setup.text: You own this home: you'll add your devices and connect ChatGPT or Claude. It takes a couple of minutes.
onboarding.welcome.owner.title: {{family}} is waiting for you
onboarding.welcome.owner.text: You'll be its owner: connect ChatGPT or Claude and invite the people close to you. It takes a minute.
onboarding.welcome.co_owner.text: You'll run the home together with its owner: invite people and decide who can use which devices. It takes a minute.
onboarding.welcome.member.title: You're invited to {{family}}
onboarding.welcome.member.text: You'll control the home's devices from ChatGPT and Claude, by chat and by voice. It takes a minute.
onboarding.family.title: What's your home called?
onboarding.family.text: ChatGPT and Claude will see your home under this name — yours and everyone's you invite.

onboarding.done.co_owner: You're a co-owner of {{family}}. Now connect ChatGPT or Claude.
onboarding.done.member: You're in {{family}}. Now connect ChatGPT or Claude.

access.owner: An owner has every device, with no end date.

consent.signin.title: Connecting to Homie
consent.subtitle: {{family}} · {{name}}
consent.elsewhere.text: It looks like this link was opened by hand or from another site — someone may have sent it. If you didn't start connecting, tap Deny: otherwise someone else's assistant gets into your home.
consent.revoke_hint: You can revoke the access any time on the Connect page.
consent.disabled.title: The home is closed to assistants right now
consent.disabled.member: Ask the home's owner to open it, then start connecting again.
consent.disabled.owner: Check the connection in Settings, then start connecting in the assistant again.
connect.title: Connect
connect.intro: One address for the whole home. Add it to ChatGPT or Claude and they can run your devices.
connect.hint: The address is copied for you. How to add it to the assistant is below.
connect.revoke.text: The assistant loses access to the home at once. You can connect it again any time.
connect.home.description: Your home's devices for ChatGPT and Claude.
connect.steps.label: Assistant
connect.steps.chatgpt.1: Tap Add to ChatGPT — the address is copied and ChatGPT's plugins open.
connect.steps.chatgpt.2: Tap Add, paste the address and name the connection {{home}}.
connect.steps.chatgpt.3: Sign in here with Face ID or Touch ID and tap Allow.
connect.steps.chatgpt.4: The first time ChatGPT asks to run an action, choose Always allow — voice won't work without it.
connect.steps.claude.1: Tap Add to Claude — the address is copied and Claude's connectors open.
connect.steps.claude.2: Choose Add custom connector, paste the address and name it {{home}}.
connect.steps.claude.3: Tap Connect, sign in here with Face ID or Touch ID and allow the access.
connect.steps.claude.4: In a chat, turn on {{home}} in the tools menu.
connect.quick: A trial address: it changes when the home computer restarts, and the connections have to be added again.
owneronly.title: This is for the owner
owneronly.text: The home's owner manages its devices and settings.

quick.text: It changes when the home computer restarts: then sign-in and the ChatGPT and Claude connections have to be set up again.
domain.title: Your own domain
domain.text: A permanent address on your domain through Cloudflare: connections stay, and so does your Face ID sign-in.
domain.host.label: Home address
domain.host.hint: The domain must be in your Cloudflare account; the free plan is enough.
domain.step.1: Add the domain to Cloudflare if it isn't there yet.
domain.step.2: On the home computer, run this command:
domain.step.3: Sign in to Cloudflare with the link it shows and pick the domain.
domain.step.4: Create your passkey again with a link from the home computer (`homed admin setup-link`): the old ones don't work on a new address.
domain.step.5: Add the new address to ChatGPT and Claude.

tunnel.title: Connection
tunnel.reconnect.footer: Restarts the connection to Cloudflare. It helps when the home stays unreachable from outside.
tunnel.reconnect.quick.text: The trial address will change, and signing in here will stop working. Continue on the home computer: the setup page shows the new address and a Reconnect button. ChatGPT and Claude have to be connected again.
tunnel.reconnect.quick.after: Open the setup page there: homed admin firstrun prints its address and PIN. It shows the new address and the Reconnect button.
tunnel.not_configured.text: The home isn't reachable from the internet yet. On the home computer, run `homed cloudflare connect <address>` or open the setup page: `homed admin firstrun`.

lan.tunnel.title: How will your home reach the internet?
lan.tunnel.text: ChatGPT and Claude reach the home through Cloudflare. No ports to open.
lan.tunnel.domain.text: A permanent address on your Cloudflare domain. For everyday use.
lan.tunnel.quick.text: A temporary Cloudflare address — for trying.

lan.domain.text: The domain must be in your Cloudflare account; the free plan is enough. Enter the address your home will live at.
